name: The Care Bears
description: The Care Bears live in a faraway place up in the clouds called Care-a-Lot. They travel around the world on Missions in Caring, whilst evil villains such as Professor Coldheart and Lord No Heart, try to thwart their plans.

videos.title: The Land Without Feelings
videos.overview: A young boy runs away from home.  He is met by evil Cold Heart, who turns him into a creppy toad-thing (seeing the transition from boy to creature is pretty scary for younger children).  The Care Bears must save the boy before it's too late and everyone is turned into uncaring toad-things.

videos.title: The Care Bears Battle the Freeze Machine
videos.overview: A persecuted boy becomes involved with the evil undertakings of Professor Coldheart for the   sole purpose of revenge against a local bully.

videos.title: The Care Bears Movie
videos.overview: Nikolas, a magician's apprentice, is in danger of getting under the influence of a bad spirit, which resides in an ancient spell book. The siblings Kim and Jason don't trust anyone anymore after being disappointed once too often. The Care Bears take them into their wonderland where they experience exciting and dangerous adventures together and quickly become good friends.

videos.title: Care Bears Movie II: A New Generation
videos.overview: This animated adventure goes back in time to the Care Bears' first-ever Caring Mission, when True Heart Bear and Noble Heart Horse touch down on Earth to boost the spirits of some unhappy kids at summer camp. But the evil Dark Heart has other plans, and convinces one of the campers to help him capture the Care Bears. Will our lovable heroes' Care Stare be enough to vanquish the villain -- and convince his apprentice that good's the way to go?

videos.title: The Care Bears Adventure in Wonderland
videos.overview: The Care Bears and Alice set out to stop an evil wizard from taking over Wonderland.

videos.title: Care Bears Nutcracker Suite
videos.overview: As the Care Bears, their newfound friends and the Nutcracker, journey through Toyland, the evil Vizier tries to stop them at all cost.

videos.title: Camp
videos.overview: During summertime, the children are preparing for the camp along with their coach and the Care Bears join in. They have been told to sleep in the tents, but they never understand. He tells a scary story about the flying phantom and that scares them away. The two boys are making a plan to make a totem pole in a different way, no matter what they think.

videos.title: The Birthday
videos.overview: The boys are not very pleased when they hear their mother announce them that they will have a sister. So, they plan to wreck the place until the Care Bear Family arrives.

videos.title: Braces
videos.overview: It is so embarrassing for Joey that he complains about having braces after his departure from the dentist. The Care Bears try to make him feel better, but it doesn't work. They also encounter a nice girl named Missy who really likes her friend the best.

videos.title: Split Decision
videos.overview: There is a boy with eyeglasses who is teased by the bullies, but supported by a girl named Mary. As the Care Bears descend, they decide to be on his side.

videos.title: The Lucky Charm
videos.overview: Proud Heart Cat is so upset that her garden is about to be ruined. She and the other Care Bear Family members see that an unlucky girl is so worried that she was going late for school.

videos.title: Soap Box Derby
videos.overview: Bedtime Bear manages to pull the cloudy blanket off of the telescope's lens, so the Care Bears can see the view more easily. Hearing the boys brag about making a car, a couple of girls with pigtails are often teased. With the help of the Care Bears, the girls build a car out of a crate and decorate it with color. This makes the boys treaten to cheat amongst the raceway.

videos.title: The Last Laugh
videos.overview: Cheer Bear learns that perseverance plays a big role in raising the spirits of a Grumpy Bear.

videos.title: The Show Must Go On
videos.overview: Patty, who's dressed up as a ballerina with fairy wings on her back, is so excited to perform in the show, but she can't do it without her dad who should be sitting on the seat. While the Care Bears are trying to cheer her up, the Care Bear Cousins help him cancel the work he is doing and they manage to fire the Cousin Call to make the boss feel nicer.

videos.title: The Forest of Misfortune
videos.overview: The Care Bears and the Care Bear Cousins are having a great time in the Forest of Feelings. The fun is spoiled when Professor Coldheart and Frostbite plan to freeze this place, but trying not to harm the Care Bear Family, they send the fortune telling machine into the forest. When they try it out, Love-a-Lot Bear reads the fortunes that tell them something good. She also reads one that comes from a bottle. Bedtime Bear warns the other Care Bears and the Care Bear Cousins that the forest is almost frozen and they all save it and Treat Heart Pig as well by using their beams which cause Professor Coldheart and Frostbite to leave.

videos.title: Magic Mirror
videos.overview: Professor Coldheart uses a magic mirror to turn the Care Bears into selfish, uncaring Bears.

videos.title: Daydreams
videos.overview: Melanie learns to balance her day dreaming reality with her grasp on reality.

videos.title: Runaway
videos.overview: Cara learns not to run away from her problems through mishaps with Professor Coldheart.

videos.title: Mayor for a Day
videos.overview: Professor Coldheart rigs an election in his favor making him a mayor that creates havoc.

videos.title: The Night the Stars Went Out
videos.overview: A well-meaning Maestro from the dark part of the galaxy, steals the stars for light to read music by.

videos.title: The Magic Shop
videos.overview: A blond-haired girl named Wendy first meets Professor Coldheart who builds up the magic shop and asks him what he is doing and he initially turns to be nice for her so after their talk, she leaves him. Then in the next day, she enters the shop with two of her friends.

videos.title: Concrete Rain
videos.overview: Professor Coldheart plots to cover the Earth with concrete with the help of Susie, a girl who loves to roller-skate.

videos.title: Dry Spell
videos.overview: Two of the kids named Elaine and Joey are so depressed because there is no water. They feel so alone in the cavern and have been first met by Share Bear who has a lighting helmet on her head.

videos.title: Drab City
videos.overview: When some of the Care Bears and some of the Care Bear Cousins see the city that's turnig colorless, they try to care for the people who feel the same thing and refuse to say what is good. However, a girl who wears a pink coat with blackish-brown hair tied in a ponytail named Jill, so colorful unlike other people, asks the Care Bear Family if they can make the city colorful again before they all turn colorless. It just fails as the other Care Bears and the other Care Bear Cousins reach to the same place, so they use the beams to make them friends again and to put the rainbow crystal into the pit to make the entire city completely colorful.

videos.title: Wedding Bells
videos.overview: Cold Heart asks Auntie Freeze to marry him, then tricks the Care Bears into letting him use Care a Lot for the wedding, convincing them that he had found love. With the help of Frostbite, Cold heart sabotages the wedding with a magic organ to destroy Care a Lot.

videos.title: The Old Man and the Lighthouse
videos.overview: Three children who are curious about the strange man who runs a nearby lighthouse get lost at sea. The Care Bears help save them, as well as teach them not to judge people because they are a little different.

videos.title: The Cloud Worm
videos.overview: Love-a-Lot Bear plans with the other Care Bears to "spread out and search Care-a-Lot" when they all hear a mysterious noise. In their search, she discovers a giant worm that eats clouds and tries to beg him not to damage Care-a-Lot because she knows it's a delicate place. After her first attempt, she brings the other Care Bears with her as her allies and together, they try to beg the Cloud Worm to stop eating the clouds. When he refuses, Care-a-Lot is ambushed and the Care Bears who drive their cloud cars save the ones who fall from the ambush. Altogether, they use a Care Bear Stare to form a rainbow that can punish the Cloud Worm until he confesses. As he complains that he's hungry, they bring him back into his own area where he can eat his own clouds in case the day gets cloudy.

videos.title: The Girl Who Called Wolf
videos.overview: This is the story of Jill, a girl who thinks it's fun to tell lies as practical jokes, but when her lies get two friends in danger, the Care Bears have to help her understand the consequences, as well as help her save her friends.

videos.title: Care-a-lot's Birthday
videos.overview: Care-A-Lot's birthday bash is put on hold when Beastly captures Hugs and Tugs and the Care Bears   must rescue them from No Heart's castle.

videos.title: Grumpy's Three Wishes
videos.overview: Grumpy ends up having to defend Care-A-Lot without the help of the other care bears! Lucky for him he has a magic clover that grants wishes. Too bad that he's not a very good wisher.

videos.title: The Great Race
videos.overview: Beastly tricks his way in the annual Care Bear obstacle race in hopes of being crowned King of   Care-A-Lot for a day.

videos.title: Home Sweet Homeless
videos.overview: Proud Heart gets a present unknowingly from No Heart which floods the Care Bear cousins out of house and home.

videos.title: Lost at Sea
videos.overview: When Hugs and Tugs accidentally set the Cloud Clipper adrift, Beastly tries to make sure the Cubs get lost forever.

videos.title: The Sleeping Giant
videos.overview: Hugs and Tugs are out playing when they stumble upon a giant who befriends them.

videos.title: The Big Star Round-up
videos.overview: No Heart unleashes a terrible demon to try and destroy the Care Bears as the drive a herd   of helpless little stars to Big Star Point.

videos.title: The Camp Out
videos.overview: The Care Bears go camping and find themselves in big trouble when they run into a swamp   monster.

videos.title: I, Robot Heart
videos.overview: Bright Heart Raccoon meets a robot that not only has a great heart, he makes great popsicles as well!

videos.title: The Bravest of the Brave
videos.overview: Brave Heart and a boy try to stop Dr. Fright, No Heart's evil accomplice who plans to trap  the Care Bears in a deserted carnival.

videos.title: The Long Lost Care Bears
videos.overview: The Care Bears discover a startling secret! In their baby picture photo album, there are two bears in there that the Care Bears and  the Care Bear Cousins know absolutely nothing about. They decide to try and find them so that they can be welcomed to the family of caring Care Bears and Care Bear Cousins. Although the two Panda Care Bears mean well, they have a great difficulty controlling their Care Bear stares. Can the Care Bears and the Care Bear Panda's overcome this difficulty and become reunited after so many years apart?

videos.title: Birthday Bear's Blues
videos.overview: When the Care Bears forget Birthday Bear's birthday, they become trapped in a maze by Noheart.

videos.title: Grams Bear's Thanksgiving Surprise
videos.overview: The evil Sour Sam is out to ruin Thanksgiving with his Crabby Apple Pies and only the Care Bears   can stop him.

videos.title: Order on the Court
videos.overview: The Care Bears have their annual basketball game.

videos.title: The All-Powerful Mr. Beastly
videos.overview: Beastly uses No Heart's broken amulet to try to capture TenderHeart and Brave Heart while they are on a caring call.

videos.title: The Cloud of Uncaring
videos.overview: The Care Bears try to help a boy named Dale not knowing that No Heart is planning to unleash a 'Cloud of Uncaring' on the world.

videos.title: The Wrath of Shreeky
videos.overview: The Care Bears help a young girl try to stop Shreeky's plan to turn the forest of Feelings into a gnarled wasteland.

videos.title: Bright Heart's Bad Day
videos.overview: When Champ prevents Mr. Beastly from ruining the Care Bear Family picnic and dumping food on  Brightheart. he vows revenge. However Beastly keeps ruining Brightheart's day at the picnic. Normally Champ would win all the events, but Brightheart was actually winning.. Beastly ruins all his chances at victory. Brightheart gets depressed and walks off to a cave. Cheer, Treatheart and Champ go look for him and Beastly traps them in the cave. Beastly gets trapped along with them and Brightheart is the one that thinks of a way to get them out.

videos.title: The Magic Lamp
videos.overview: In this caring tale Grams tells the exciting Arabian adventure of how Champ must find a magic lamp in the city of Badhgag.

videos.title: Desert Gold
videos.overview: Hugs and Tugs try to help Brave Heart and Shreeky from getting a map, which will lead them to a valley of gold.

videos.title: The Gift of Caring
videos.overview: Cheer Bear and a young girl named Carole learn the importance of asking for help when they take on a job that is too big for them.

videos.title: The Two Princesses
videos.overview: Treat Heart and Cheer learn to appreciate each other and work together when they are confronted  by an evil two headed monster.

videos.title: The Cloud Monster
videos.overview: When Beastly ruins No-Heart's experiment to create a creature that would stop the Care Bears, Beastly creates a cloud monster. Shreeky uses the monster to eat the clouds of Care-A-Lot. Meanwhile, Brightheart is creating a cloud making machine that can get Beastly and Shreeky trapped in clouds instead of going to tummy symbol practice like Braveheart wants him to. When the monster attacks, Brightheart ruins the team's care bear stare. He lster uses his machine to stop the monster.

videos.title: Grumpy the Clumsy
videos.overview: In Gram's exciting caring tale, Viking Grumpy persists in overcoming his clumsiness when he   tries to become someone he's not.

videos.title: The Purple Chariot
videos.overview: Grams tells the story of ancient Rome where Champ tries to turn Brave Heart back into the champion chariot racer he once was.

videos.title: The Caring Crystals
videos.overview: Grumpy must save the day when No Heart unleashes his evil bubbles of uncaring on a village.

videos.title: The Best Way to Make Friends
videos.overview: Treat Heart sets out to make a video about how to make friends but ends up losing her friends by constantly laughing at them.

videos.title: The Care Bear Town Parade
videos.overview: Beastly uses Cheer to get his car into Care Bear Town's parade. The car is designed to ruin the parade and destroy Care-A-Lot.

videos.title: Hearts at Sea
videos.overview: Cheer brings a pet onboard the SS Friendship that grows out of control.

videos.title: No Business Like Snow Business
videos.overview: Champ helps a young skier regain his confidence after an accident. Shreeky and Beastly do their best to stop him. Meanwhile Hugs, Tugs and Grumpy go sking.

videos.title: The Factory of Uncaring
videos.overview: Champ shirks his duty of guarding the Caring Meter giving No Heart a perfect opportunity to   cover a town with uncaring smoke.

videos.title: The Lost Gift
videos.overview: Grams tells Hugs and Tugs how a magical apple tree fed an entire village until greed destroyed it.

videos.title: Lotsa Heart's Wish
videos.overview: After helping a unicorn, Forest Ranger Lotsa Heart is granted three wishes with unexpected results.  He then decides that being a forest ranger is the right thing for him.

videos.title: The Showdown
videos.overview: The Care Bears try to help a young rodeo boy learn that how you feel about yourself is what really counts.

videos.title: Caring for Spring
videos.overview: Mother Nature is captured by the witch of winter, and if Hugs and Tugs don't rescue her by sunset, it will be winter forever.

videos.title: The Turnabout
videos.overview: When No Heart creates a fog to keep the Care Bears from helping people, Braveheart puts the Care Bear team in charge of putting the Caring Beacon in the tower and watching Hugs and Tugs.   Champ tells Cheer and Treatheart to watch the cubs, but Cheers dares him and Brightheart to watch them instead. So the girls keep watch over the beacon and the boys watches the cubs.

videos.title: Cheer of the Jungle
videos.overview: Cheer, a city girl, visits Champ in the jungle but soon learns not to judge something by looks alone.

videos.title: Beautiful Dreamer
videos.overview: Grams tells a story of a Broadway star who gives a young washer woman the confidence to go   onstage and perform in a show.

videos.title: Care Bear Carneys
videos.overview: Beastly and Shreeky trick the Care Bears away from their work and into a carnival they've set   up as a trap to capture them.

videos.title: The Pirate Treasure
videos.overview: Beastly takes Champ and Treat Heart prisoner on the high seas and Hugs and Tugs try to save   them with the help of a pirate.

videos.title: Grin & Bear It
videos.overview: When No Heart banishes Beastly, he tries to join the Care Bears but discovers being a good guy is more than he can stand.

videos.title: Perils of the Pyramid
videos.overview: Hugs and Tugs teach gung-ho archeologist Brave Heart to look before you leap as they enter a booby-trapped pyramid.

videos.title: Bedtime for Care-a-Lot
videos.overview: Bedtime Bear is the only one who can save the other Care Bears who have been put to sleep by   Noheart's magical sleeping sand.

videos.title: The Fountain Of Youth
videos.overview: Champ Bear, with help from Braveheart Lion, goes on a quest to find a fountain whose water makes everyone younger--but Beastly and Shrieky will stop at nothing to find it too.

videos.title: Treat Heart Baba And The Two Thieves
videos.overview: Treat Heart plays the role of Ali Baba in this episode with Beastly and Shriekly playing the roles of the theiving villains. Treat Heart must outwit the two villains in order to rescue the other Care Bears missing stuff.

videos.title: Dr. Brightenstein's Monster
videos.overview: Hugs and Tugs learn that just because someone acts or looks different dosn't mean they're not

videos.title: The Care Fair Scare
videos.overview: The Care Bears organize a fair to cheer children up and make them happy but Shreeky and Beastly   are determined to destroy it.

videos.title: Mystery Of The Phantom
videos.overview: Grams recounts how a group of Care Bears overcome their fears to fix up an old theatre haunted   by a mysterious phantom.

videos.title: Under The Big Top
videos.overview: Brave Heart and Grumpy help a small boy be part of the circus unaware that the evil duo   Beastly and Shreeky are out to trap them.

videos.title: The Most Ancient Gift
videos.overview: Grams tells a story of ancient Egypt, Beastly and Shreeky try to break the friendship between   two neighboring countries by stealing a precious gift.

videos.title: Ski Trouble
videos.overview: Bright Heart goes skiing by himself, and is nearly captured by Beastly and Shreeky.

videos.title: The Care Bears' Exercise Show
videos.overview: Champ Bear hosts an exercise show complete with a warm up aerobics, and many helpful fitness   tips.

videos.title: The Care-A-Lot Games
videos.overview: The city of Care-A-Lot is holding its Care-A-Lot Games, an event similar to the Olympics in the human world.  As fast as the games start, Shrieky and Beastly team up to cheat their way to winning all the medals.

videos.title: Gram's Cooking Corner
videos.overview: Gram's bear has a new cooking show on TV and she's baking cookies. Even Beastly watches it and tries to make some.

videos.title: A Care Bear's Look at Food Facts And Fables
videos.overview: The Care Bears host a fascinating potpourri of cooking trivia and yummy recipes that children can do themselves.

videos.title: The Thing That Came to Stay
videos.overview: A wild animal Cheer brings on board the S.s. Friendship creates so much trouble that she soon learns animals should remain in the wild.

videos.title: The Space Bubbles
videos.overview: When the Care Bears help a marooned Space Clown, Grumpy unfortunately gets the brunt of the   Clown's practical jokes.

videos.title: Cheer Bear’s Chance
videos.overview: Cheer must prove herself to the rest of the crew when Beastly and Shreeky attack the SS Friendship.

videos.title: A Hungry Little Guy
videos.overview: Beastly and Shreeky place an alien on board the SS Friendship to create havoc among the crew   members so they can take over.

videos.title: King Of The Moon
videos.overview: Brave Heart believes he's not needed by his crew and becomes the King of the Moon but soon   learns that they need him after all.

videos.title: On Duty
videos.overview: Treat Hear learns there is a time to work and a time to play because of her, Shreeky captures   Hugs and Tugs.

videos.title: The Secret of the Box
videos.overview: Trouble starts when the crew of the SS Friendship become obsessed with opening a box to be   delivered to an alien planet.

videos.title: The Frozen Forest
videos.overview: The crew of the SS Friendship is in big trouble when Beastly and Shreeky plan to use a freezing   ray and turn them to ice.

videos.title: Grumpy's Little Friend
videos.overview: Grumpy wants to see his little dinosaur friend again but has more to contend with when Shreeky   and Beastly attack Cavetown and only he can defend it.

videos.title: One Million C.B.
videos.overview: To avoid doing their chores, Hugs and Tugs pretend to come down with a terrible sickness. Only one thing will "cure" the two baby Care Bears: a tear from No-Heartsaurus, and he has never cried before. With Grams and Brave Heart willing to risk life and limb for the cubs, Hugs and Tugs' guilty consciences attempt to let them reveal their secret.

videos.title: Tugs The Brave
videos.overview: Little Tugs tries to be like his hero Brave Heart but realizes he'd rather be himself when he   confronts a dangerous dinosaur.

videos.title: Coconut Crazy
videos.overview: Brave Heart doesn't think much of Bright Heart's zany inventions but soon changes his tune   when one of them saves Cavetown.

videos.title: Bad Luck Friday
videos.overview: Brave Heart must overcome his superstitions on Friday the 13th and save the other Care Bears who are lost in the jungle.

videos.title: Food Frolics
videos.overview: The Care Bears are baffled when a usually friendly dinosaur turns mysteriously hostile and   starts wrecking their garden.

videos.title: It's Raining, It's Boring
videos.overview: On a rainy day Hugs and Tugs overcome the Bast of Boredom by finding lots of exciting things   to do.

videos.title: A Day Without Tugs
videos.overview: With Tugs sick in bed, Hugs spends a fun filled day doing many activities with her newfound friend - her own shadow.

videos.title: The Fabulous Care Bear's Safety Game
videos.overview: The Care Bears explain what you should and shouldn't do when it comes to being safe around the house with Beastly providing the wrong answers and Brave Heart Lion providing the right answers.

videos.title: A Rhyme in Time
videos.overview: While Grams read the Cubs safety Rhymes, Hugs and Tugs daydream and act out they have heard.

videos.title: Songfellow Strum and His Magic Train
videos.overview: The Care Bears visit with a singing minstrel in a place called Musicland.

videos.title: The Music Video
videos.overview: The Care Bears attend a music concert with the singing minstrel.

videos.title: Care Bears Nutcracker Suite
videos.overview: As the Care Bears, their newfound friends and the Nutcracker, journey through Toyland, the evil Vizier tries to stop them at all cost.
